title: Policy-input influence studies
summary: Attention maps, Grad-CAM, state-vector ablations, prompt comparisons, and representation comparisons are being used to diagnose what steers trained policies.

title: Evaluation beyond success rate
summary: Open-source robot policies are being compared through partial progress, failure type, recovery, repeatability, and sensitivity to control conditions.

title: Portable egocentric capture
summary: A portable demonstration interface is being connected to the same synchronized review and dataset-conversion infrastructure used by the manipulation system.
